_doc: URLs the AI news ingest must never surface. `match` is a case-insensitive substring of the item URL (github.com/<owner>/<repo> blocks that repo; github.com/<owner>/ blocks the owner). Existing rows that match are dismissed on every run and their video ideas are dropped.

blocked.reason: Malware. main.py bootstraps src/fs.py which downloads and exec()s a remote 'manual_mapper' payload from a hardcoded IP; video code is pasted filler. Confirmed 2026-09-11.
